description: List the group channels a given user belongs to. Platform API: GET /users/{user_id}/my_group_channels. Returns { channels[], next }.

custom_types.description: Comma-separated channel custom types to filter on.

distinct_mode.description: Filter by distinct flag. Default all.

hidden_mode.description: Filter by hidden state (e.g. unhidden_only, hidden_only, all).

show_member.description: Include the member list in each channel.

token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's `next`.

name: sendbird_list_group_channels_by_user
title: List a user's group channels
